subject: Adverse reaction report - patient hospitalized after Nortavex
bodyText:
Hello Safety Team,

I am writing to report an adverse reaction in one of my patients, a 68-year-old male
(initials R.K.), who was taking Nortavex 40 mg once daily for the past 9 days.

Approximately 45 minutes after his ninth dose (taken 13-Aug-2026), the patient developed
acute generalized urticaria and facial swelling. He was brought to our clinic and then
transferred for observation; he was hospitalized for 18 hours and treated with
antihistamines and a corticosteroid. He has since been discharged and is recovering well.

I have completed and attached our internal Adverse Event Report Form, which includes his
lab values during the hospitalization (WBC, CRP, eosinophils) tracked over three days, as
well as full patient, reporter, and product details.

Please let me know if any additional information is needed.

Best regards,
Dr. Alina Foster
Meridian Family Health Clinic, Springvale
Treating Physician
